keyEvents.text: Goal! Real Madrid 1, Rayo Vallecano 0. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Real Madrid 2, Rayo Vallecano 0. Álvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Kylian Mbappé.
Goal! Real Madrid 3, Rayo Vallecano 0. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Vinícius Júnior.
First Half ends, Real Madrid 3, Rayo Vallecano 0.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Eduardo Camavinga replaces Federico Valverde.
Second Half begins Real Madrid 3, Rayo Vallecano 0.
Goal! Real Madrid 3, Rayo Vallecano 1. Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Rayane Belaid replaces Pedro Díaz.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Óscar Valentín replaces Gnangoro because of an injury.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Aurélien Tchouaméni replaces Bernardo Silva.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Arda Güler replaces Yan Diomande.
Delay in match because of an injury Aurélien Tchouaméni (Real Madrid).
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Alemão replaces Sergio Camello.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Mujaid Sadick replaces Unai López.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Pathé Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Iván Balliu replaces Adrià Pedrosa.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Marc Cucurella replaces Vinícius Júnior.
Goal! Real Madrid 4, Rayo Vallecano 1. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Arda Güler following a fast break.
